items.text: New disease: marginal zone lymphomas, with gastric MALT, non-gastric MALT, nodal and splenic disease kept apart and the trials that enrolled several subtypes grouped separately: 60 studies on antibiotics and antivirals, radiotherapy, rituximab and chemoimmunotherapy, BTK inhibitors, lenalidomide and CAR T cells, with trials to watch and new drugs to watch.

New topic: Waldenström macroglobulinemia and lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma, untreated and relapsed disease together: 30 studies on BTK inhibitors and venetoclax, rituximab and chemoimmunotherapy, proteasome inhibitor regimens, and the definition, risk scores and MYD88 and CXCR4 genotypes, with trials to watch and new drugs to watch.

New topic: Richter transformation, first-line and relapsed disease together: 45 studies on risk, biology and diagnosis, chemoimmunotherapy and transplantation, BTK, BCL2 and checkpoint inhibitors, bispecific antibodies and CAR T cells, and the Hodgkin variant, with a Perspective, trials to watch and new drugs to watch.

New topic: relapsed/refractory chronic lymphocytic leukemia, 26 studies from chemoimmunotherapy to BTK inhibitors and their head-to-head trials, venetoclax-based therapy, PI3K inhibitors and treatment after both drug classes, with a Perspective, trials to watch and new drugs to watch.

New disease: chronic lymphocytic leukemia. The first topic, untreated CLL, covers 30 studies from chemoimmunotherapy to continuous BTK inhibitors and fixed-duration venetoclax combinations, with a Perspective, trials to watch and new drugs to watch.

New topic: primary bone lymphoma, an evidence map of 39 studies in adults (treatment series, registries, prognosis, single versus multiple lesions, biology, circulating tumor DNA, non-DLBCL histologies, imaging), with a grid showing what has and has not been published, and a Perspective on how to read this evidence.
